_from: docs/game-guide/templates/art-config.json. One painting per mine depth (0 to 20) for the Mines screen and that depth's fights (docs/CLANS-FIGHT-FEEL.md, stage 4).

styles.a: Dark gritty painterly medieval fantasy game art, hand-painted oil texture, rich muted earthy colours with warm firelight glow, dramatic cinematic light, suitable for children aged 8 to 12, an empty quiet place, no writing, no letters, no numbers anywhere.
